values.itemsExtrasOnly: only the selected extras (no item pool is on)

souls.noEffect: no effect (turn on world items, NPC gifts or enemy drops)
souls.shuffled: Shuffled (the lesser souls move with the other items; the boss souls stay with their bosses)
souls.replaced: Replaced (the lesser souls become other consumables)
souls.transposed: Transposed (the boss souls join the item pool; each has a 75% chance to become a weapon made from that soul)

keys.vanilla: stay where the game puts them (progression items are protected)
keys.shuffled: Shuffled (placed by a safety-checked fill over the world graph: every area stays reachable and Firelink Altar can be reached; gifts, shops and drops never hold a key)
keys.race: Race Mode (the keys and embers lie only in boss rewards, chests and the places where keys normally are; the same safety check applies)
keys.race-plus: Race Mode + (as Race Mode, but a world may need skips and glitches such as the Capra skip or the Seal skip to be completed; softlocking is possible without them)

vessel.vanilla: stays where the game puts it (given by Gwynevere)
vessel.shuffled: shuffled with the keys (Gwynevere then hands over another item of the pool)

lordSouls.vanilla: stay where the game puts them (the rewards of the four Lords)
lordSouls.shuffled: shuffled with the keys (the four rewards go to other pickups, and the Lords drop other items)

difficulty.fair: Fair (items have an equal chance to be placed anywhere)
difficulty.unfair: Unfair (desirable items are not placed in plain view)
difficulty.very-unfair: Very Unfair (desirable items are hidden and rarely in early areas)

values.laundromatOn: on (NPC characters wear armor pieces other NPCs wear; only their appearance and armor stats change)

placement.sampling: Sampling (each slot chooses a compatible replacement)
placement.permutation: Classic permutation (the existing enemies are shuffled)
